What kind of organizing is happening on 8chan et al right now? I just don't trust things right now. Is this all about George Floyd?

I worry other groups will take advantage of the situation to agitate for their own agenda.

People can be assholes. 
Stay safe!  #BlackLivesMatter

If you feel depressed or anxious? If you feel exhausted or guilty? If you are angry or confused?

You are normal. 

Feel what you need to feel. Do what you need to do work thru your trauma. 

(For those who don't feel this way. You are the problem.)
#BlackLivesMatter #GeorgeFloyd

I should mention that the police know what burking is. Anyone who studies criminal justice learns about Burke & Hare (it was 200 yrs ago).

You cannot convince me that cops don't know it's a way to kill & not leave marks on a body. 
#BLM 
#NativeLivesMatter 
#LatinxLivesMatter

If you haven't watched it yet, you should.
#MeToo
